Whale Rock Capital Management Has Cut Its Ellie Mae (ELLI) Holding as Valuation Declined; Netflix (NFLX) Shareholder Tybourne Capital Management Hk LTD Has Raised Position by $96.78 Million as Market Valuation Rose
May 13, 2018 - By Maria Brooks
Eashwar Krishnan increased its stake in Netflix Inc (NFLX) by 43.44% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Tybourne Capital Management Hk Ltd bought 506,700 shares as the company’s stock rose 58.31% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Eashwar Krishnan held 1.67M shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $321.19 million, up from 1.17M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Tybourne Capital Management Hk Ltd who had been investing in Netflix Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $141.91 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.95% or $3.14 $326.46. About 4.59M shares traded. Netflix, Inc. (NASDAQ:NFLX) has risen 108.73% uptrending. It has outperformed by 97.18% the S&P500.
Alex Sacerdote decreased its stake in Ellie Mae Inc (ELLI) by 12.18% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Whale Rock Capital Management Llc sold 109,455 shares as the company’s stock declined 0.57% with the market. The hedge fund run by Alex Sacerdote held 789,136 shares of the technology company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $70.55M, down from 898,591 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Whale Rock Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Ellie Mae Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $3.61 billion market cap company.
